svg.title: From a fridge video to a shared list
svg.desc: Fictional grocery example. A fridge video with narration adds strawberry yogurt, with plain yogurt as a fallback note. OpenClaw and ShadowOS read the current task and instructions, then update the shared list. Text, voice, images and short video are supported inputs.

path.aria-label: If unavailable, plain yogurt is fine.”
